wiki.title: Mike Wilson (Kentucky politician)
wiki.extract: Mike Wilson (born December 4, 1951) is an American politician and a Republican member of the Kentucky Senate representing District 32 since January 2011. He has served as the Senate Majority Whip since 2018. He is also a veteran of the US Marine Corps.
